label: Bible Study
prompt: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and _____ my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
verse: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
note: Young Jeremiah protested that he was just a child — so God touched his mouth and filled it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of _____ round about Elisha.
verse: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.
note: Elisha's servant saw an enemy army all around; one prayer later, he saw the hills full of chariots of fire.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the barbarous people shewed us no little _____: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
verse: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
note: Shipwrecked and soaked, Paul's company found the islanders of Melita showed 'no little kindness' — and lit a fire.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had _____ for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verse: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!
note: David's lament over Absalom, the son who tried to steal his throne — victory news that broke his heart.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: It is the spirit that _____; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
verse: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
note: 'Quickeneth' means gives life. Moments later Peter answers: 'thou hast the words of eternal life' (verse 68).
